title: kaava-bench-v1 schema carries every ingested probe result
context: Alternative approaches: separate schemas per metric; text output with parsing; no versioning.
decision: CI runs probes and emits `kaava-bench-v1` artifact files. The schema version is `kaava-bench-v1`. Schematify ingests the artifact into `runs/` and draws it. The schema is versioned; a reader that meets an unknown version rejects the file and reports the version.
consequences: Versioning allows schema evolution; breaking changes can be detected; Schematify never invokes the probe command itself; CI controls the probe and Schematify ingest; version mismatch is an error, not silent data loss.
